posts.community: Yash High Voltage Ltd : Transformer Guardians
posts.text: The bushing chokepoint is the smoking gun. In Apar Q3 FY26 concall, MD Kushal Desai blamed conductor volume de-growth (-5.9% YoY) on delays in transformer deliveries that are coming out of a lack of supply of bushings Which is resulting in some of the substation work getting delayed and in turn the transmission line work getting delayed. This is the same chokepoint KEC MD called the critical bottleneck. Both companies are flagging the same physical constraint.
